summary.text: Jim Struzzi is a Republican state representative from Indiana County who has represented Pennsylvania House District 62 since December 2018 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He chairs the House Republican Appropriations Committee for the 2025-26 session.

paragraphs.text: Struzzi graduated from Penn Trafford High School, earned a degree in electrical wiring from a technical school near Pittsburgh, and received a bachelor's degree in English writing from the University of Pittsburgh at Greensburg, according to his official biography.
His career before the legislature included work as a journalist, as press secretary for PennDOT District 11, and as president of the Indiana County Chamber of Commerce.
He has also written children's and young adult books set in Indiana County.
Struzzi assumed office on December 1, 2018, and his biography says he is in his fourth term.

His biography lists his priorities as reducing government spending, eliminating burdensome taxes, creating jobs, school choice, and protecting state and national constitutions and Second Amendment rights.
Ballotpedia lists Democrat Trajan Jones as his opponent in the general election.
